title: WhoisFreaks Threat Intelligence (using Azure Functions)
descriptionMarkdown:
The WhoisFreaks data connector ingests WhoisFreaks threat intelligence and newly registered domain feeds into Microsoft Sentinel through an Azure Function and the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. The solution supports malware, phishing, spam, and NRD feeds.

**Installing this Content Hub solution registers the connector UI only.** It does not create the Function App, storage account, Data Collection Endpoint, Data Collection Rule, or custom tables. After installing, use the **Deploy to Azure** button in the instructions below to deploy that infrastructure -- that deployment is where you provide your WhoisFreaks API key and choose which feeds to enable. You can change feed enable/disable flags afterwards in the Function App application settings (`WHOISFREAKS_FEED_*_ENABLED`).

graphQueries.baseQuery: union isfuzzy=true WhoisFreaksMalware_CL, WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL, WhoisFreaksSpam_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithoutWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithoutWhois_CL | summarize Count=count()

sampleQueries.query:
WhoisFreaksMalware_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 20

union isfuzzy=true WhoisFreaksMalware_CL, WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL, WhoisFreaksSpam_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithoutWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithoutWhois_CL
| summarize count() by Type

value:
union isfuzzy=true WhoisFreaksMalware_CL, WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL, WhoisFreaksSpam_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithoutWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithoutWhois_CL
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(30d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions on the workspace are required.

read permissions to shared keys for the workspace are required. [See the documentation to learn more about workspace keys](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/platform/agent-windows#obtain-workspace-id-and-key).

customs.name: WhoisFreaks API key
customs.description: A valid WhoisFreaks API key is required. It is collected securely when you deploy the infrastructure template (Deploy to Azure button, step 1 below) and stored as Function App setting WHOISFREAKS_API_KEY -- not during Content Hub installation itself.

customs.name: Microsoft.Web/sites permissions
customs.description: Read and write permissions to Azure Functions to create a Function App is required. [See the documentation to learn more about Azure Functions](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/).

instructionSteps.description: >**NOTE:** This connector uses an Azure Function and the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. Azure Functions and Log Analytics ingestion can incur Azure charges.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Deploy the infrastructure
instructionSteps.description:
Installing this solution from Content Hub registers the connector UI only -- it does not create any Azure resources. Click **Deploy to Azure** below to deploy the Function App, storage account, Data Collection Endpoint, Data Collection Rule and the 7 custom Log Analytics tables into the same resource group as this Microsoft Sentinel workspace.

[![Deploy To Azure](https://aka.ms/deploytoazurebutton)](https://portal.azure.com/#create/Microsoft.Template/uri/https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FAzure%2FAzure-Sentinel%2Fmaster%2FSolutions%2FWhoisfreaks%2Fazuredeploy%2Fazuredeploy.json)

You will be prompted for the Microsoft Sentinel workspace name, your WhoisFreaks API key, and which feeds to enable (Malware, Phishing, Spam, NRD variants). Enable only the feeds included in your WhoisFreaks subscription.

instructionSteps.title: 2. (Optional) Change feeds after deployment
instructionSteps.description:
Open the Function App → Configuration → Application settings and set any of:

- `WHOISFREAKS_FEED_MALWARE_ENABLED`
- `WHOISFREAKS_FEED_PHISHING_ENABLED`
- `WHOISFREAKS_FEED_SPAM_ENABLED`
- `WHOISFREAKS_FEED_NRD_GTLD_WITH_WHOIS_ENABLED`
- `WHOISFREAKS_FEED_NRD_CCTLD_WITH_WHOIS_ENABLED`
- `WHOISFREAKS_FEED_NRD_GTLD_WITHOUT_WHOIS_ENABLED`
- `WHOISFREAKS_FEED_NRD_CCTLD_WITHOUT_WHOIS_ENABLED`

to `true` or `false`, then save and restart if needed.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Verify ingestion
instructionSteps.description:
After the timer runs (daily 00:00 UTC) or after invoking the Function `/api/run` endpoint, query for example:

`WhoisFreaksMalware_CL | sort by TimeGenerated desc`

value:
union isfuzzy=true WhoisFreaksMalware_CL, WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL, WhoisFreaksSpam_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithoutWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithoutWhois_CL
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(30d)
